scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem is for symmetric Jacobi weights and degree-two orthogonal projections. The crossing set is specified implicitly; uniqueness of the crossing is not established. An equivalent unindexed result cannot be excluded. Proof and numerical checks were reviewed internally; no independent audit was performed. The older 2006 work is bibliographically dated by year rather than a verified day-level first-public date.
title: Sharp two-branch monotone range envelope for quadratic symmetric Jacobi projection
